author: Spread
name: Status pill
description: A pill that glows green when on (DRS open, pit lane, online). The label is its text.
svg: <svg viewBox="0 0 140 56"><style>.cap{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;fill:currentColor;opacity:.7}.num{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:200;fill:currentColor;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.trk{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.12}.b{fill:currentColor;fill-opacity:.1;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.25;transition:fill .4s,stroke .4s}[data-state="on"] .b{fill:#16a34a;fill-opacity:.9;stroke:#4ade80;stroke-opacity:1}.g{opacity:0;transition:opacity .4s}[data-state="on"] .g{opacity:.7}.t{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:20px;letter-spacing:.14em;fill:currentColor;opacity:.55}[data-state="on"] .t{fill:#fff;opacity:1}</style><defs><filter id="pg" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="6"/></filter></defs><rect class="g" x="12" y="10" width="116" height="36" rx="18" fill="#22c55e" filter="url(#pg)"/><rect class="b" x="12" y="10" width="116" height="36" rx="18"/><text x="70" y="35" text-anchor="middle" class="t">{{label}}</text></svg>
